# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

ContribKit is delivered as a continuously deployed web app, public API, and
mobile app. Only the latest released version is supported. Security fixes are
applied to the current `main` branch and rolled out from there.

| Component            | Supported |
| -------------------- | --------- |
| Web app & public API | ✅ Latest deploy |
| Mobile app           | ✅ Latest release |
| Older versions       | ❌ Not supported |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue, pull request, or discussion for security
vulnerabilities.

Report privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/fbuireu/contribKit/security/advisories/new).
If that is unavailable, write to **contact@contribkit.app** with the details.

When reporting, include where possible:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact.
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept.
- Affected component (web app, public API, or mobile app) and version or URL.
- Any suggested remediation.

## What to Expect

- **Acknowledgement** within 72 hours of the report.
- **Initial assessment** of severity and validity within 7 days.
- **Resolution updates** as a fix is developed and deployed.
- **Coordinated disclosure**: once a fix is released, credit is offered to the
  reporter unless anonymity is preferred.

Reports made in good faith will not result in legal action. Thank you for
helping keep ContribKit and its users safe.
